findings.body: The overlay mounts `./deploy/mongo/kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py` into the container, but the repository may not contain that file. I attempted to look it up but the lookup system could not search the tree or read arbitrary files. If the script is missing, the container will fail to start. The author should confirm the path is correct and the script is committed.
findings.title: Verify that kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py exists at the mounted path

findings.body: The overlay references services `mongod` and `mongo-secrets`, but I could not read `docker-compose.yml` to verify those names exist and are of the expected type. A typo or mismatch would cause `docker compose up` to fail. The author should confirm that the base Compose file defines these services exactly as named.
findings.title: Confirm that the base docker-compose.yml defines service names 'mongod' and 'mongo-secrets'

value.summary: This change adds a Docker Compose overlay to work around a kernel compatibility issue with the MongoDB community-server image, setting `GLIBC_TUNABLES` and replacing the entrypoint with a Python shim. Without being able to verify that the referenced Python script and base Compose file exist and are correctly referenced, I cannot confirm the change is safe to merge.
